note: Mountain ranges (phase 2, docs/making-original-grids.md). Points are [frontierRow, frontierCol] grid units along the crest; halfWidthTiles = [at the tips, in the middle]; ground = the tile under and around the mountains (DI dirt in green country, SL slate in slate country such as the Inferno or Halloween). Ranges are completely impassable: every band tile is covered.

ranges.name: Prospero's Range, north-east arm
ranges.purpose: With the south-west arm, a big C round Prospero's home (1013320) that players must go round one way or the other on the way to the Oracle. East tip in 1013305.

ranges.name: Prospero's Range, south-west arm
ranges.purpose: The other half of the C; south tip in 1013266.

ranges.name: King's Circle north bank range
ranges.purpose: Hugs the north (inland) bank of King's Circle River from 1015321 to 1015337, ending on the north bank above the little town in 1015336; the crest follows the real bank, on slate about 8.5 tiles inland, the band within 0-3 tiles of the water.

ranges.name: King's Circle north bank range, spur (west)
ranges.purpose: Mountains bleeding inland off the bank range.

ranges.name: King's Circle north bank range, spur (east)
ranges.purpose: Mountains bleeding inland off the bank range.

ranges.name: The Swoop (C range east of centre)
ranges.purpose: A swooping C: lower-left tip in 1014337, east along the bottom, then curving up and north-east to its tip in 1014403; opens to the west. Passes east of the spreadsheet's 🫅 anchor at (33,34), which stays free for its scenario. Grass under the mountains (owner's call).

checks.name: across Prospero's home (the joint of the two arms)

ownerPatched.note: Owner grids already extended by phase2_owner_patch.mjs (run it ONCE per grid and range; it adds on top of what is there). Owner-approved: 1013320 (2026-10-09, Prospero's Range); 1015320-1015322 and 1015332-1015337 (2026-10-09, King's Circle north bank range).

seamFixed.note: Owner grids whose mountain seams seam_fix.mjs --owner --loose-owner closed on 2026-10-09 (owner asked for every gap between grids closed): only trees, rocks and doobers cleared; never water, roads, cobbles or snow; sand and lava keep their ground. After restoring/re-patching any owner grid, run the seam fix again.
